title: One slow product blocks the shop
scenario: Customers have reported that the availability refresh is slow or that products are not available. Our expert team has already identified a fault in the Lighting inventory service. They say it has something to to with the availability of service workers. Now you are tasked to find the issue and mitigate it.
why: The StoreFront uses two workers to process all inventory service requests. Sometimes there is a delay in the availability refresh and other products are unavailable.
reproduce: Try to add a 1500 ms delay to Lighting inventory to reproduce the issue. See what happens. Can you identify the impact?
assignment: Assignment: Can you keep chair and desk available while lamp stock is delayed or unavailable?

fields.label: Healthy baseline and metric
fields.prompt: Record your baseline. Include all the data you identify as relevant from Grafana into your notes.

fields.label: Hypothesis and fault injection
fields.prompt: What will +1500 ms Lighting inventory delay affect? What could be the blast radius? Write your hypothesis and introduce the fault.

fields.label: Fault evidence
fields.prompt: Record Lighting inventory latency and customer impact. Include all the data from Grafana that changed compared to the baseline.

fields.label: Mitigation and reason
fields.prompt: For this challenge, apply the predefined fallback in the fault console. Explain what it does. Why should it help?

fields.label: Same-fault validation
fields.prompt: Compare the identical fault after mitigation was introduced. Measure the impact on the Storefront and in Grafana and explain what happens.

fields.label: Conclusion and cleanup
fields.prompt: What fault did you introduce? What mitigation did you use? What improved? When you reset the fault, what happens?

solution: Healthy: All products and the catalog return live data quickly. Use your measured timings.
Slow lamp calls occupy the two shared workers. Healthy products can queue or fail.
The 400 ms timeout releases workers sooner. The breaker pauses failed lamp calls for 5 seconds. The fallback returns unconfirmed stock while chair and desk stay live.
Recovery may briefly increase latency. Remove faults, restore defaults and verify recovery.
